question: Settle whether Brave's USD 5 monthly credit needs the Brave Search API to be attributed on the project's website or about page, as one first-party post says, or is applied automatically, as the plan page says.
why: The launch post of 2026-02-12, updated 2026-06-25, says 'To take advantage of this free credit, all you need to do is attribute the Brave Search API in your project’s website / about pages' (https://brave.com/blog/most-powerful-search-api-for-ai/); the plan page says 'Credits are automatically applied to your account', and neither the quickstart nor the FAQ names an attribution step. Whether the credit is withheld without attribution shows only inside an account, behind a sign-up and a card, so crawler-scraper/brave-search records the credit as applied automatically and does not state the condition.
